# Supabase browser SDK

`supabase-2.116.0.js` is the unmodified UMD build of `@supabase/supabase-js` version 2.116.0.

Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2.116.0/dist/umd/supabase.js

Serve this directory with the HTML pages. This avoids a runtime dependency on the CDN and keeps SDK updates explicit. Supabase's license is MIT; see `supabase-LICENSE`.
